data.one_liner: A widget that displays a widget alongside its source code side-by-side.
data.what_it_does: Wraps a Flutter widget to provide a side-by-side or tabbed view showing its actual implementation source code. It highlights syntax using flutter_highlight and can open code links in the browser.
use_when: Building widget catalogs or tutorial apps where source code needs to be shown alongside UI examples.
Showcasing component libraries with live code inspection.
avoid_when: Standard production applications that do not need to expose source code to users.
When source files cannot be embedded as assets in the app bundle.
strengths: Provides an easy way to display source code views next to running widgets.
Supports custom themes for code highlighting and tab change listeners.
weaknesses: Requires manual addition of source code files to pubspec.yaml assets.
Increases application bundle size by bundling source text as assets.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding source code files to the assets section of pubspec.yaml.
